notes:
The substrate contains roughly 120 chapter-marks visible in the Coptic numerals (ⲕ̄ⲃ̄=22 at §1238 through ⲣⲕ̄=120 at §5500), but I have grouped some content into single teachings where the spiritual arc clearly continues across a `---` marker, while I have split a few exceptionally long sections (notably §2009-2287 split into 3 teachings about cosmic body, Adam-from-Watchers, and soul-in-body) where the underlying spiritual subject genuinely shifts.

Particularly difficult boundaries:
- §743-942 is treated as ONE extended teaching about the Twelve Greatnesses' descent culminating in Jesus reaching Adam — the arc is genuinely continuous despite covering ~200 sections, with the Mother of Life, the lonely-righteous-one image, the judgment court, the cosmos-builders, and Jesus's plasma-encounter all serving the single redemptive narrative. Could plausibly be split into 3-4 sub-teachings (§743/§786/§830/§895) but the substrate reads as one arc.
- §1304-1395 vs §1277-1303: split because §1277 is purely about Eternity (mēnōg) while §1304 introduces Hyle's autonomous self-formation as the Enthymesis of Death — a genuinely different spiritual subject.
- §1396-1587 (~200 sections) treated as one teaching on cosmic time/building/end, though it could plausibly be subdivided.
- §3398-3568 is the cognition-as-city teaching, distinguishable from the prior Adam-molding teaching at §3264 by its sustained focus on the senses functioning as rooms/storehouses/guards.
- §4537-§4670 region is highly fragmentary; identified as 2 separate teachings with low confidence.
- §5505+ at the very end is too fragmentary to subdivide reliably; treated as one final unit despite likely containing multiple original teachings (cherubim, pillars, garments, marriage themes all surface).

The chapter-number markers (Coptic numerals) generally align with my boundaries: chapters 22-37 map cleanly to teachings 21-37 in my list, chapter 42 begins at §2419 (teaching 44), chapter 49-50 at §3026/§3050 (teachings 51-52), etc. Small offsets reflect cases where I joined or split based on spiritual content.
